label: Continue, then complete
description: Two rounds: the first classifies continue and loops conclude; the second classifies complete and the loop stops.
scenario: A representative Backlog Conclusion run over one plan-less research item that needs two rounds to finish.

handoff.summary: Round 1 of the conclusion investigated the item and drafted the deliverable; more remains.

steps.note: handoff.progress=continue L1-derives at the edge → loops conclude
handoff.progress=complete L1-derives at the edge → guarded stop
